description: This file contains implementation of logging classes for the Orleans testing host, including a file-based logger and a logging output handler that manages log file writing, formatting, and disposal.

classes.name: FileLoggingOutput
classes.description: Handles writing log messages to a file, manages log file flushing, and disposes resources properly.

classes.name: FileLogger
classes.description: Implements the ILogger interface to log messages to a specified file logging output, supporting scope and enabled checks.

classes.name: NullScope
classes.description: A singleton disposable scope that does nothing, used for BeginScope implementation.

methods.name: FileLoggingOutput()
methods.description: Constructor initializing log file name and stream writer.

methods.name: Log()
methods.description: Logs a message with specified log level, event ID, state, exception, formatter, and category.

methods.name: FormatMessage()
methods.description: Formats a log message with timestamp, thread ID, log level, error code, caller, message, and exception details.

methods.name: Dispose()
methods.description: Disposes the log output, flushing buffers and releasing resources.

methods.name: FileLogger()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the logger with a log output and category.

methods.name: BeginScope()
methods.description: Returns a disposable scope, here a singleton NullScope.

methods.name: IsEnabled()
methods.description: Indicates whether logging is enabled; always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: Log()
methods.description: Delegates log message to the associated FileLoggingOutput.
